title: P6 Activity Release 26 primary baseline typed semantic evidence tranche
reference_version: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
certification_rule: This artifact certifies only documented read-side API type and semantic description. Writable/default/nullability/import-export certification remains open; no Registry identity is changed by this tranche.

fields.description: Duration for the activity in the primary baseline; working time from current start to current finish, using the activity calendar.
Current finish date of the activity in the primary baseline; Oracle documents status-dependent selection of planned, remaining, or actual finish date.
Planned duration for the activity in the primary baseline; working time from current start to current finish, using the activity calendar.
Planned costs for project expenses associated with the activity in the primary baseline.
Cost at completion for labor resources in the primary baseline, computed from baseline at-completion labor units; fallback uses baseline labor units and project default price/time.
Planned units for labor resources assigned to the activity in the primary baseline.
Planned material cost for a primary baseline activity.
Planned costs for nonlabor resources in the primary baseline; fallback computes from planned nonlabor units and project default price/time.
Planned units for nonlabor resources assigned to the activity in the primary baseline.
Planned total cost in the primary baseline including labor, nonlabor, and project expenses; total is the sum of those components.
Current start date of the activity in the primary baseline; Oracle documents planned start until started, then actual start.
